rules.conflict: If the field also changed in HubSpot, it is not sent: each side keeps its value and the record is counted as a conflict, with the field name only.
rules.echo: What the sync brought from HubSpot is not sent back, and what we send does not come back as a conflict.
rules.create: A record created here is created in HubSpot. A contact with an email or a company with a domain that HubSpot already has is linked to that one instead.
rules.associations: Associations added here are added in HubSpot. Removing one here does not remove it there.
rules.deletes: Deleting a record here never deletes it in HubSpot: the link is only marked.
rules.pause: Pausing the sync above pauses both directions.
